items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And opposite us was Scatman Crothers and his band... And again, Scatman Crothers was opposite of us, hah-hah, with his band.

ctx.x: Right. And at the club, Slim Gaillard, the great entertainer and musician, he was like a mainstay at Billy Berg's. At that time he had Big Tiny playing the bass. And he'd use the great Leo Watson, who was one of the early scat singers and played drums and trombone. Scatman Crothers also worked with him out there later on.
